    "description": "Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

# pr-1381: fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe

## Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —

- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1381
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1381
- **Title**: fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1378-ios-aiinby-sso-callback` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style). - **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340

- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard).     "summary": "fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe",
    "description": "Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340

- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). - **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

  "fields": {
    "summary": "fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe",
    "description": "Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1381
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1381
- **Title**: fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1378-ios-aiinby-sso-callback` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style). - **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit

- **State**: open

- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style). ## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1381
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1381
- **Title**: fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1378-ios-aiinby-sso-callback` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style). Swift side: no device here — static proof only; CI device legs are the real gate.

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style). Swift side: no device here — static proof only; CI device legs are the real gate.

Now I understand the mobile wiring: `openBrowserFn` = the iOS branch that calls `_openAiinAuthSession(url)` — this resolves only when the sheet completes. `opened` = `_openAiinBrowser(...)` wrapping this — so `opened` is the future that hangs on the dead sheet. The fix: `await opened.timeout(_sheetSettleGrace)` — after the callback lands, give the sheet 3s to settle; if not, status line and continue. Correct.

One question: after the timeout fires, when the sheet eventually resolves (say user swipes it away 60s later), `opened` completes — the `.timeout()`'s internal `then` handlers swallow it. Good. But what about the `intercepted` completer — `intercepted.complete(callbackUrl)` — `interceptedCallback` was already consumed by `_wireInterceptedChannel`? `_firstCallbackOrOpenError` wired listeners on it. When it later completes with a callback URL... hmm, wait — the race already finished (callbackFuture won). `_wireInterceptedChannel`'s `intercepted.then` handler: if URL != null and `interceptedCallback` completer not completed → completes it — but nobody listens to `interceptedCallback.future` anymore (the Future.any already settled and its listeners ran; late listeners on Future.any... Future.any's result future already completed, so a late complete is a no-op — `interceptedCallback.complete()` on an unlistened future is fine, no unhandled error since the value is a value, not an error).

If the sheet later resolves with null (user cancel), `_wireInterceptedChannel` → surfaceClosed.completeError(AiinSurfaceClosedException) if not completed. `surfaceClosed.future.ignore()` was called — `ignore()` marks errors as handled. Good.

And `openError.future.ignore()` similarly. Good — no unhandled async errors.

Now, one more edge: `await opened.timeout(_sheetSettleGrace)` — if `opened` completes with an error AFTER the timeout, handled by the `.timeout` internal listener. Good.

Another potential issue: the flow continues to `_settleAiinCallback` while the sheet is still open on iOS. When the exchange completes and `_completeAiinConnect` pushes the model picker... the dead sheet may still be on screen (the `cancel` dismissal was already sent but "resolves nothing" — meaning the native side may not have dismissed it?). Actually in the repro, "the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing" — the channel call returns null. ## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). **Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:

- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340

- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1381
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1381
- **Title**: fix(1378): iOS aiin.by SSO — bound the post-callback sheet settle, full post-callback logging; manual adds run the endpoint-confirmation probe
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1378-ios-aiinby-sso-callback` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style). Now I understand the mobile wiring: `openBrowserFn` = the iOS branch that calls `_openAiinAuthSession(url)` — this resolves only when the sheet completes. `opened` = `_openAiinBrowser(...)` wrapping this — so `opened` is the future that hangs on the dead sheet. The fix: `await opened.timeout(_sheetSettleGrace)` — after the callback lands, give the sheet 3s to settle; if not, status line and continue. Correct.

One question: after the timeout fires, when the sheet eventually resolves (say user swipes it away 60s later), `opened` completes — the `.timeout()`'s internal `then` handlers swallow it. Good. But what about the `intercepted` completer — `intercepted.complete(callbackUrl)` — `interceptedCallback` was already consumed by `_wireInterceptedChannel`? `_firstCallbackOrOpenError` wired listeners on it. When it later completes with a callback URL... hmm, wait — the race already finished (callbackFuture won). `_wireInterceptedChannel`'s `intercepted.then` handler: if URL != null and `interceptedCallback` completer not completed → completes it — but nobody listens to `interceptedCallback.future` anymore (the Future.any already settled and its listeners ran; late listeners on Future.any... Future.any's result future already completed, so a late complete is a no-op — `interceptedCallback.complete()` on an unlistened future is fine, no unhandled error since the value is a value, not an error).

If the sheet later resolves with null (user cancel), `_wireInterceptedChannel` → surfaceClosed.completeError(AiinSurfaceClosedException) if not completed. `surfaceClosed.future.ignore()` was called — `ignore()` marks errors as handled. Good.

And `openError.future.ignore()` similarly. Good — no unhandled async errors.

Now, one more edge: `await opened.timeout(_sheetSettleGrace)` — if `opened` completes with an error AFTER the timeout, handled by the `.timeout` internal listener. Good.

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1378-ios-aiinby-sso-callback` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

    "description": "Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit

- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +340
- **Deletions**: -18
- **Created**: 2026-10-07T12:44:47Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-07T12:55:38Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1378

## Root cause (bug 1 — callback lands, flow never completes)

The post-callback `await opened` in `runAiinConnectCliFlow` was **unbounded**. On iOS, `opened` is the `fah/web_auth_session` `authenticate` channel call, which resolves only when the `ASWebAuthenticationSession` completion handler fires. On build 211 the `http`-scheme interception is dead (Apple-deprecated — the log confirms the **loopback leg** won), the flow's `cancel` dismissal resolves nothing, the completion handler never fires → the flow hung at `await opened` **forever**: no exchange log, no completion, no error, the provider-add latch stuck "in progress" (refusing reconfigure 63s later). Exactly the reported signature.

**Fix (flow-driver layer, generalized):** once the callback has landed, the surface's settle is cosmetic — it now gets a **3s grace**, then a visible status line ("the sign-in sheet did not close after the callback — continuing without it") and the flow proceeds to the exchange. The exchange/registration steps announce themselves, so every post-callback step is answerable from the log alone; combined with the existing `sendProviderFetch` watchdogs (#1036) there is no unbounded silent wait left — any failure ends the flow with a visible error and releases the latch (AC1/AC2).

## Fix (bug 2 — manual-code path lands a dark "unknown" tile)

No add path ran any endpoint confirmation after landing an entry. Manual adds now kick the **same live quota probe the row's gauge reads** at add time:
- `QuotaStore.confirmEndpoint(baseUrl)` — settings' add CTA;
- the add-provider picker's shared `_confirmQuotaFor` — the **Custom tile** (the paste-key/manual path) and key-based preset tiles, service passed through `ProvidersSection`.

A fresh entry resolves from live data instead of sitting on a cold/dark cache until the next pull-to-refresh.

## Delivered
- AC1/AC2: bounded post-callback settle + full post-callback step logging; every failure path surfaces and releases the latch.
- AC3: manual adds schedule the endpoint-confirmation probe (picker + QuotaStore), quota-marked entries probe live at add time.
- AC4: regression tests —
  - `flutter_app/test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart` «gh-1378»: the device repro end-to-end — dead sheet (authenticate never resolves, `cancel` settles nothing), callback lands on the REAL loopback server over a raw socket, flow completes to the model picker. **Verified failing-first** (stash run: fails on main).
  - AC3 wiring tests: `packages/fa_ui/test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` «gh-1378 AC3» + `flutter_app/test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` «confirmEndpoint».

## Remaining / notes
- The literal dark string `endpoint not pinned (OQ1) — dark until confirmed` is the CodeMie quota adapter's designed-by-open-question state (`lib/src/providers/quota_codemie.dart`): an `api.aiin.by` entry carries no quota gauge at all; a **codemie-marked** entry stays dark until the OQ1 limits-endpoint pin lands (fixture-first parse, owner-owned open question — inventing the endpoint here would fabricate the contract). The probe scheduled by this PR re-evaluates the moment the pin lands.
- The iOS side (AppDelegate `fah/web_auth_session`) is untouched — the fix is entirely at the Dart flow-driver layer, so the Swift channel keeps its semantics for the surfaces that do resolve.

## Local verification disclosure
System dart is SIGKILLed on this box (exit 137, known machine guard). All gates ran via the temp Flutter/Dart SDK 3.13.4 + fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`: core `dart test test/cli/aiin_connect_server_test.dart test/cli/aiin_provider_commands_test.dart` 25/25; `flutter_app` `flutter test test/aiin_mobile_connect_test.dart test/quota_store_badge_test.dart` 13/13; `packages/fa_ui` `flutter test test/add_provider_picker_test.dart` 11/11; `dart analyze` clean on every touched dir; `dart format` applied (one untouched settings.dart line kept in repo style).
